title: The Think-Pair-Share Question Engine
description: Produces a sequence of think-pair-share prompts at varying cognitive levels for a 50-minute class session, paced to fit the lecture flow.
framing_paragraph: This recipe defines The Think-Pair-Share Question Engine, a teaching-focused agent that fits the use case in the description above. Use it when that description matches what you want the agent to do in your course. The agent works best when its Instructions field is calibrated against two or three representative prompts before you share the resulting agent with students or colleagues.
